data.name: Soletair Power
data.description: Soletair Power is a Finnish direct air capture company (founded 2016, HQ Lappeenranta) that integrates modular CO2 capture units into building ventilation systems, turning commercial buildings into distributed DAC sinks. Deployments include Wärtsilä's Sustainable Technology Hub in Vaasa, ZBT in Duisburg, Danica Pension's Europaplads building in Aarhus, and a Vantaa factory, with partnerships including Carbonaide (net-negative concrete) and Aarksee (microalgae sequestration in the Middle East/India).
